health_system_expense.basis: Medical Center (UChicago Medicine) column 'Total operating expenses' in Schedule 2 Consolidating Statement of Activities, BEFORE eliminations. FY25 report PDF p.55 (5,159,515 thousand; consolidated-level eliminations of (748,969) are not allocated by column); FY24 report PDF p.56 (4,514,222; eliminations (153,367)); FY23 report PDF p.51 (3,719,074; eliminations (132,141)).

medical_center_salaries.note: All Medical Center salaries are shown as 'Staff salaries'; academic salaries are 0 in the Medical Center column.

alt_measure_functional_healthcare_servic.note: Functional expense classification 'Healthcare service' total, FY25 report PDF p.52 (after eliminations).

entities_included.ffrdc: Argonne National Laboratory (UChicago Argonne LLC) and Fermilab (member of Fermi Research Alliance) are NOT consolidated: 'expenditures under the respective contracts and the related reimbursements ... are not included in the consolidated statements of activities.' Disclosed expenditures/reimbursements: ANL 1,247,313,000 and Fermilab 731,552,000 in FY25; ANL 1,221,143,000 and Fermilab 735,699,000 in FY24; ANL 1,283,947,000 and Fermilab 607,795,000 in FY23 (FY25 report Note 15 PDF p.53; FY24 report PDF p.54; FY23 report PDF p.49). Excluded from all figures above.
entities_included.other: Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) consolidated (FY25 opex 54,599,000). The Medical Center holds a controlling (51%) interest in AdventHealth Great Lakes Region, consolidated via member substitution (the FY25 report's cash flow statement shows the related net-asset contribution, 302,379,000, in the 2024 column, so FY24 is the year it entered; it likely contributes to the FY23-to-FY24 growth in Medical Center expense). NORC is an affiliate not consolidated. Operating expenses include a non-controlling interest in a consolidated joint venture (net loss (13,270,000) FY25 shown below the operating total, not removed from it).

calibration_fy23.explanation: S&W: exact match. Academic salaries 799,601 + Staff salaries 2,233,499 = 3,033,100 thousand = the reference 3,033,100,000 (0.0% diff), benefits excluded and Medical Center staff included. Core opex: the reference 6,779,655,000 equals FY23 TOTAL operating expenses exactly (6,779,655 thousand). Against the SPEC definition (total minus depreciation 363,977,000 minus interest 199,853,000 = 6,215,825,000) the reference is 8.3% higher, because the original analysis did not deduct depreciation or interest.

student_counts_in_official_docs: None. The audited statements state that the University enrolls undergraduate, graduate and professional students (Note 1) but give no enrollment counts.
caveats: Salaries and wages = Academic salaries + Staff salaries (two lines); benefits (FY25 839,139,000) are separate. Consolidated S&W includes UChicago Medicine staff salaries (FY25 1,727,968,000 in Schedule 2) and MBL.

Health-system expense given before consolidation eliminations (FY25 eliminations 748,969,000 at consolidated total level vs 153,367,000 in FY24 and 132,141,000 in FY23), so Medical Center expense is not strictly like-for-like across years and overstates the amount inside the consolidated total. The FY24-to-FY25 jump in eliminations suggests a broader intercompany elimination in FY25; the FY25 report does not present a 2024 consolidating column to compare.
FY24 line items 'Utilities, alterations, and repairs' and 'Supplies, services, and other' were reclassified between the FY24 report and the FY25 comparative (sum unchanged, total opex unchanged).

Total operating expenses is the Operating section total; the nonoperating net periodic benefit credit other than service cost ((13,787,000) FY25) is outside it. The functional-expense table total (8,269,255,000) is after that credit and is not used.
Interest is presented inside operating expenses (not nonoperating). No separate amortization line in operating expenses; amortization is null.
Argonne and Fermilab expenditures (about 2.0B in FY25) are excluded from the consolidated statements by design; not in any figure here.
